::: overview
**Overview.** Daniel sees four beasts rise from the sea, then a scene in heaven where one “like the son of man” receives a kingdom that will never be destroyed.
:::

## The vision of the four beasts {.main-sub}

### Verses 1-8 {.vgroup}

Daniel records a dream he had in the first year of Belshazzar. The beasts represent powers that rise and fall, and the chapter moves quickly from the sea to the throne room.

## The kingdom given to the Son of man {.main-sub}

### Verses 13-14 {.vgroup}

Read Daniel 7:14 in your own Bible.

The contrast is the point of the chapter. The earthly powers are temporary, but this kingdom is **given by God** *and it does not pass away.*

::: cta
Take a moment to read Daniel 7:13-14 aloud before moving on to chapter 8.
:::
